regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, DOI, and ESI availability statement
regions.finding: The true article title and aggregate 70–99% method claim were inspected. The paper mentions ESI, but workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI facts were imported.
Pseudoxyloallenicins B, eucalyptene A, xyloallenolide A, and terricollene A are occurrence/examples, not current-paper reaction arrows; no experiment records were fabricated for them.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b established Ar-X plus alcohol coupling
regions.finding: Classified as a generic literature example with [Cu]/[Pd], ligand, and base; it is not a current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1c failed aryl-halide/allenol path and current phenol/carbonate path
regions.finding: The failed 4-iodoanisole/allenol preliminary survey is retained as an unresolved trace-result record because catalyst-specific details are only referred to unassociated ESI. The lower phenol/allenylic-carbonate arrow is a general current scheme; row-level results are recorded separately.

unresolved: The preliminary palladium/copper failures cannot be separated into exact trials from the main text.
Natural-product structures are contextual examples, not preparations on page 1.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–11, and footnotes a/b
regions.finding: Eleven independent optimization conditions were retained with catalyst, ligand, solvent, 1a scale, 2a equivalents, 1 mL solvent, room temperature/12 h, NMR yields, recoveries or dash markers, CH3NO2 basis, and entry-9 1 mmol/95% isolated result. Entry 1 retains both the table [Pd] 5 mol% convention and prose 2.5 mol% dimer loading.

regions.region: page 2 prose describing preliminary survey and optimization
regions.finding: The trace failed survey maps to the page-1 unresolved record; prose yields/recoveries map to Table 1 rows and were not duplicated.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2 reaction header, product drawings 3ba–3va, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Twenty-one distinct phenol/naphthol scope experiments were retained. Shared quantities and each marked solvent/catalyst/temperature/carbonate-amount/sealed-tube override are structured; all displayed yields are isolated and product-targeted.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 1 uses catalyst loading conventions that differ by whether palladium atoms or dimer are counted.
Table 1/Table 2 omit most workups, purifications, masses, atmosphere, and reaction times for Table 2.

regions.finding: Narrative yields and substituent identities for 3ma–3va were linked to the existing Table 2 rows; no prose-only duplicates were created.

regions.region: page 3 Table 3 reaction header, product drawings 3bb–3pp, and footnote a
regions.finding: Fifteen independent allenylic-carbonate scope rows were retained with phenol/naphthol identity, carbonate label, Pd2dba3/Xantphos, Et2O 5 mL, room temperature, and isolated product yield.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2a gram-scale 3ga formation and four outgoing transformation arrows
regions.finding: The 5 mmol gram-scale coupling is separate from Table 2 entry 6. Four independent 3ga transformations to 4, 5, 6, and (Z)-7 retain their reagents/loadings, solvent ratios, yields, and product-specific Z/E or E/Z/selectivity statements.
A distinct 1 mmol methyl 4-hydroxycinnamate/2a experiment with Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol% in Et2O at room temperature gives eucalyptene A in 90%; unprinted time and yield basis remain missing.

The 70 mmol preparation of allene 10 is a distinct experiment. The D-glucose-to-terricollene sequence is represented as ordered silylation, 30 min iodination, 4 h glycosylation, and desilylation stages; 4.5 g/58% is retained as an overall yield based on D-glucose, not a last-step yield.

unresolved: Most Scheme 2 arrows omit scale or reagent quantities, reaction time, workup, purification, isolated masses, or yield basis.
The terricollene route omits individual stage yields and most reagent/solvent quantities.
Substituted carbonate/product machine structures remain uncertain and unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 3 and mechanism paragraph
regions.finding: Pd(0), carbonate 2, CO2/MeO- release, proposed alpha-methylene-pi-allylic Pd intermediate Int, phenol attack, and product 3 comprise a proposed mechanism; Int is not an isolated preparation.

regions.region: page 4 left-column continuation of terricollene A synthesis
regions.finding: The text confirms allene 10 (7.15 g), glucosyl iodide formation within 30 min at room temperature, glycosylation for 4 h at room temperature, methanol/resin desilylation, and terricollene A 4.5 g/58% overall as sole anomer. These facts enrich the page-3 records without creating duplicates.
